claude-instant-v1.feature: Use case: fast, lightweight conversational tasks such as simple Q&A, summarization, classification, rewriting, and basic text analysis. Use when low latency and lower cost are more important than deep reasoning or complex problem solving.

claude-v1.feature: Use case: general-purpose language understanding and generation, including reasoning, writing, summarization, analysis, and multi-step instructions. Use when a task needs stronger language understanding than a lightweight model but does not require highly specialized reasoning.

claude-v2.feature: Use case: complex instruction following, long-form writing, reasoning, coding, document analysis, and detailed question answering. Use when the prompt requires stronger reasoning or handling of long and information-dense inputs.

gpt-3.5-turbo-1106.feature: Use case: routine conversational AI, text generation, summarization, extraction, classification, simple coding, and structured-output tasks. Use when the prompt is straightforward and does not require advanced reasoning, with priority on cost efficiency and response speed.

gpt-4-1106-preview.feature: Use case: complex reasoning, advanced coding, difficult analysis, long-context document understanding, and tasks requiring strong instruction following. Use when a prompt is substantially more difficult than routine generation and benefits from GPT-4-level capability or a large context window.

meta/code-llama-instruct-34b-chat.feature: Use case: code generation, code completion, debugging, code explanation, and programming-focused instruction following across multiple languages. Use when the prompt is primarily a software-development task and a specialized open-weight coding model is preferred.

meta/llama-2-70b-chat.feature: Use case: general conversational assistance, question answering, reasoning, summarization, and instruction following using an open-weight model. Use when a strong general-purpose open model is needed for conversational tasks without relying on a proprietary API.

mistralai/mistral-7b-chat.feature: Use case: lightweight general-purpose chat, instruction following, summarization, rewriting, and basic reasoning. Use when the task is relatively simple and the system needs a smaller, faster open-weight model with lower inference requirements.
mistralai/mistral-7b-chat.service: Self-hosted / Hugging Face / Cloud hosting providers

mistralai/mixtral-8x7b-chat.feature: Use case: general chat, reasoning, coding, summarization, multilingual generation, and more demanding instruction-following tasks. Use when a task needs more capability than a small dense model while retaining relatively efficient MoE inference.
mistralai/mixtral-8x7b-chat.service: Self-hosted / Hugging Face / Cloud hosting providers

WizardLM/WizardLM-13B-V1.2.feature: Use case: instruction following, conversational assistance, detailed responses, reasoning, and general-purpose text generation. Use when a task needs more instruction-following capability than a small lightweight model but does not justify a much larger model.

zero-one-ai/Yi-34B-Chat.feature: Use case: general conversational AI, reasoning, writing, summarization, and especially English/Chinese bilingual tasks. Use when the prompt requires a capable open-weight general-purpose model or when Chinese-language understanding and generation are important.
zero-one-ai/Yi-34B-Chat.service: Self-hosted / Hugging Face / Cloud hosting providers
